{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute response rate per site, including counts
response_rates = data_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].agg(['mean', 'count']).round(4)
response_rates = response_rates.rename(columns={'mean': 'response_rate', 'count': 'n_patients'})
response_rates = response_rates.sort_values('response_rate', ascending=False)

# Print detailed table
print(response_rates)"}
